::api-operation{method="PATCH" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/meters/{meter}"}
#docs
After the first counted event or the first price on the meter, only `name` can change. Any other field is refused with 409: create a new meter instead.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `meter` | `string` | **yes** | The meter's id: the slug you chose. |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | The meter's name. |
| `event_name` | `string` | no | The event name it reads. |
| `aggregation` | `string` | no | How events combine in a period. `avg` = total of the values ÷ number of events. `unique` counts distinct values of `unique_property`. `weighted_sum` bills a level × the time it held. One of `sum`, `count`, `min`, `max`, `avg`, `last`, `unique`, `weighted_sum`. |
| `value_property` | `string` | no | The property holding the number. Required except for `count`. |
| `unique_property` | `string` | no | `unique` only: the property whose distinct values are counted. |
| `recurring` | `boolean` | no | sum, last, max and unique only: the level carries into the next period. |
| `time_unit` | `string` | no | `weighted_sum` only. One of `hour`, `day`. |
| `filters` | `object` | no | An event counts only when every listed property has one of its values. |
| `group_by` | `array of string` | no | Up to 5 property names, in order. A price can set a rate for each combination. |
| `limit_dimensions` | `array of string` | no | Up to 3 event properties a spend limit can name (`property_key`), so each value of the property has its own limit. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `price_list` | `object` | no | Maps each combination to a model price list key, for `model_price_list` prices and line cost. Each key it reads must be in `group_by`. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `price_list.provider` | `string` | no | The list provider for every event. |
| `price_list.provider_key` | `string` | no | Or: the group key that names the provider. |
| `price_list.model_key` | `string` | no | The group key that names the model. Default `model`. |
| `price_list.token_type` | `string` | no | The token type for every event, such as `input`. |
| `price_list.token_type_key` | `string` | no | Or: the group key that names the token type. |
| `cost_currency` | `string` | no | The currency of event `cost` for events that name none. Null = the price's currency. |
| `expected_version` | `integer` | no | Refuse the write if the meter changed. |

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `meter`. One of `meter`. |
| `id` | `string` | The meter's id. |
| `name` | `string` | The meter's name. |
| `event_name` | `string` | The event name it reads. |
| `aggregation` | `string` | How events combine in a period. `avg` = total of the values ÷ number of events. `unique` counts distinct values of `unique_property`. `weighted_sum` bills a level × the time it held. One of `sum`, `count`, `min`, `max`, `avg`, `last`, `unique`, `weighted_sum`. |
| `value_property` | `string` | The property holding the number. Required except for `count`. |
| `unique_property` | `string` | `unique` only: the property whose distinct values are counted. |
| `recurring` | `boolean` | sum, last, max and unique only: the level carries into the next period. |
| `time_unit` | `string` | `weighted_sum` only. One of `hour`, `day`. |
| `filters` | `object` | An event counts only when every listed property has one of its values. |
| `group_by` | `array of string` | Up to 5 property names, in order. A price can set a rate for each combination. |
| `limit_dimensions` | `array of string` | Up to 3 event properties a spend limit can name (`property_key`), so each value of the property has its own limit. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `price_list` | `object` | Maps each combination to a model price list key, for `model_price_list` prices and line cost. Each key it reads must be in `group_by`. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `cost_currency` | `string` | The currency of event `cost` for events that name none. Null = the price's currency. |
| `status` | `string` | The meter's status. One of `active`, `archived`. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | True once the meter has a counted event or a price: only `name` can change. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the meter was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the meter was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The meter. |
| `404` | No such meter. |
| `409` | The meter has usage, so this field cannot change. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/meters/Meter" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "AI tokens"
  }'
```
